text:
Mike: heads-up — seeing a spike of OOMs in prod serving pool after the kernel-selector change rolled at 09:50UTC. Alerts started ~10:03UTC. stack traces point to workspace allocator failures. kernel_selector=v2.1, model=redwood-open-7b-ft, seq_len tail around 1800-2200. Any quick mitigation suggestions?

deploy-bot: Deploy completed: kernel-selector v2.1 -> rollout 80% at 09:50UTC

Anya: on it. can you paste nvidia-smi and the runtime error snippet? which pool?

Mike: prod-gpu-64. nvidia-smi shows ~94% memory. runtime log: "oom while allocating workspace in runtime_workspace.cu". lots of concurrent chat sessions with long contexts.

Luis: that matches a kernel selection regression — v2.1 picked larger tiled kernels for medium seqs which raises per-request workspace. quick options: pin selector back to v2.0 for the pool, or route long-context requests to a quantized fallback. also consider request-shaping (reject/trim requests > 1024).

Priya: prefer non-rollback first. try these runtime knobs: ENABLE_BUFFER_REUSE=true, lower WORKSPACE_POOL_LIMIT from 0.8 -> 0.6, and temporarily disable kv-cache for long-lived sessions (kv_cache.ttl_hours=6) to free GPU KV memory.

Mike: can you paste the hot-config we can apply?

Anya: applying now — snippet: 

```
# runtime config override for pool: prod-gpu-64
kernel_selector: v2.0
runtime_env:
  ENABLE_BUFFER_REUSE: "true"
  WORKSPACE_POOL_LIMIT: "0.6"
kv_cache:
  ttl_hours: 6
circuit_breakers:
  max_seq_len_per_request: 1024
  reject_rate: 0.05
```

Rolling this as a console hot-config to the pool.

deploy-bot: Hot config applied to prod-gpu-64 at 10:12UTC

Luis: add routing rule for heavy requests: seq_len > 1024 -> low_mem_variant (4-bit quant). also set runtime fallback: if gpu_mem_used_pct > 90 -> route to dedicated-slo-pool OR return 429 with header `x-rw-fallback: quantized`.

Priya: also add a temporary soft-reserve bump (+6%) so inflight batches can finish and degrade gracefully — watch tail latency.

Mike: what metrics/alerts should we watch to validate the fix?

Anya: monitor per-pod gpu_mem_used, workspace_alloc_failures, kvcache_entries, OOM_kills, p95 latency, fallback_rate. add alert: OOM_kills > 3 in 5m -> page eng-runtime.

Luis: for the post-incident follow-up: grab minidumps from affected pods, kernel-selector decision logs, nvprof/trace for failing requests, batch size distribution and seq_len histogram. add a regression test that replays our seq_len tail against kernel-selector to assert workspace < threshold.

Mike: if this config doesn't stabilize within 15m we rollback selector entirely. I'll coordinate. thanks. :pray:

sre-bot: Incident recorded: INC-2026-0423-0810. Assigned: eng-runtime.

Priya: quick note for playbook: include steps to 1) hot-config buffer reuse 2) reduce workspace pool limit 3) enable request shaping/circuit breaker 4) route to quantized fallback 5) rollback selector. keep the sequence in that order to avoid churn.

Mike: acknowledged. I'll capture this thread for the incident timeline and start the memory profiling run now.
